description:
Read a crypto wallet check again, or collect one that was still running.

A crypto wallet address is checked as an address, never as a name. This
reads the check crypto_wallet_screen started, by its `check_id`, and
answers the same verdict block. Reading it again starts nothing new.

`pending` (`running: true`) means it is still running: ask again in a
minute. `pending` and `incomplete` are not finished, never nothing
found. The meaning of every field is in crypto_wallet_screen.

Examples:
  crypto_wallet_result("01JD8Q7T6XK3M5N9P2R4S6V8W0")

api_key.description: Your Ohmyfin API key (prod-...). Optional here: it can be sent instead as a KEY header or an Authorization: Bearer header. What the tool requires of the key is in its description.
